prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up shot of a person’s hand holding a smartphone, with the screen prominently displaying the title “MOBILE STRIKE” and an image of armed soldiers in military gear. The hand is slightly tanned and masculine, with short, neatly trimmed nails, and the person is wearing a dark, possibly navy or black, suit jacket. The background is softly blurred with warm, golden bokeh lights, suggesting an upscale, dimly lit interior—perhaps an elevator or a sophisticated lobby. The lighting is moody and cinematic, casting gentle highlights on the hand and phone, while the rest of the scene fades into shadow. The composition is tight and intimate, focusing attention on the phone’s screen and the subtle tension in the hand’s grip. The overall color palette is warm and muted, with deep shadows and soft highlights, evoking a sense of suspense or anticipation. The camera angle is slightly over-the-shoulder, creating a voyeuristic perspective, and the shallow depth of field isolates the subject from the background, enhancing the dramatic, filmic quality of the scene.
